summary: A visual taste graph tied to shopping intent — hard for a text-first model to replace.
moat: Pinterest's moat is a human-curated visual taste graph mapping billions of images to concrete purchase intent, monetized through commerce. Generative image tools can produce inspiration, but they lack Pinterest's link between a saved idea, a real product, and a shopper ready to buy, which keeps advertisers and users anchored to the platform.

challengers.name: Generative image tools (e.g. Midjourney)
challengers.evidence: Text-to-image generators offer on-demand inspiration, but report no shopping/commerce graph tying images to purchasable products.
